title: Parents 'watering down baby milk' over high costs
summary: Parents are resorting to diluting baby milk to cope with rising living costs, according to Moorside Baby Bank, creating health risks for infants. The practice underscores the severe financial strain families face in affording basic necessities.
content: Moorside Baby Bank say parents are turning to unsafe practices over the rising cost of essentials.

zh.title: 父母因高昂成本"稀释婴儿奶粉"
zh.summary: 根据Moorside婴儿银行的数据，父母为应对不断上升的生活成本而稀释婴儿奶粉，这对婴儿造成了健康风险。这种做法突显了家庭在负担基本生活必需品方面面临的严重经济压力。
